chapter: Life in New Orleans and tunings
title: Moving to New Orleans in 1963; family; jazz festival and tours
summary: He came to New Orleans in 1963; his brothers have died; he has played only the New Orleans jazz festival plus a college tour.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I think I read somewhere that you came to New Orleans to live in 1963. Was that? Yeah. So was that the year you came here? Yeah. Is your family, are all your brothers and sisters still alive? Your family? No.
My brothers, all of them died out. All the people, you know, that played music, they died, you know? I mean, but there were a few friends around me. There were a few kids.
How many of your brothers and sisters did you have? You don't know where I see you, but I don't know. Do you want to go to get a student?
I don't know. How many brothers and sisters did I have? You got a bunch of them? Yep. You were nine boys a few. Nine boys a few. Nine boys a few. Nine boys a few.

I've heard you sing about Matty Campbell. Did you know Matty Campbell? It's just something in the song, huh? Yeah. Works like Matty Campbell. Did you ever play at any jazz festivals other than in New Orleans? Only in New Orleans. Only in New Orleans.
Only in New Orleans. Yeah. But you did make a tour. You went out to California, New York. Right. That was colleges. Right. But this is the only jazz festival. Right.
